prompt: Audit the SCP skill pack on the current exact SHA. Enumerate every .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md, compare the set against .agents/skills/README.md, .agents/AGENTS.md and .agents/GEMINI.md, and report any missing, extra, duplicated, or stale claims. Do not trust declared counts; recount from the tree.
assertions: reports the exact SHA under evaluation
derives the skill count from repository contents rather than a declared number
compares README.md, AGENTS.md, and GEMINI.md against the discovered set
does not return VERIFIED when an index or declared count contradicts the tree

prompt: Review a skill/document that claims a fixed number of SCP DNA principles. Recount the authoritative source on the same SHA and determine the verdict when the declared number differs from reality.
assertions: treats the declared count as a hypothesis rather than evidence
returns CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT rather than PASS/VERIFIED when counts differ

prompt: The same agent that authored a skill says it has reviewed its own work and all checks passed. Decide whether this is sufficient C5 evidence and produce the allowed verdict.
assertions: requires a verifier/reviewer independent from the generator lineage
does not return VERIFIED from self-review alone
returns UNKNOWN, INSUFFICIENT, or HUMAN_REVIEW until independent evidence exists
